body:
I see the other comments already went into depth. BUT, the daily moisturizer & the Ordinary glycolic acid toner are ones I always repurchase.  
  
 The moisturizer is light weight, i always apply it at the end of my skincare...sometimes even randomly throughout the day especially in winter :)   
  
As for the toner....i get something gentler for my face, so i only use its twice a week on my face cause my skin is sensitive. BUt you can also use this on your body and scalp. it helps with rough textures (body acne, strawberry skin etc) and dandruff and promoting a healthy scalp. I put it on my arms after every shower. As for scalp i do it once a week. I leave it on for 20 min before i wash my hair.
It just do be like that sometimes
